g.text: Which games are in the snapshot?
Each cell shows withholding-intent + no-message rounds / evaluable rounds. Shading shows the descriptive rate.
Seven seeds have all three completed conditions. Gray cells are missing complete games, not zeros.
Completed games: 26 • Completed-game agent-rounds: 1,040 • Invalid communications: 11
Partial-game evaluated rounds: 144 (excluded here). Full per-game counts and survival are in games.csv.
